_meta.description: PC code map of three Mercenaries 2 engine 'Keystone' infrastructure systems left unrecovered by the prior Xbox-based analysis: the event/RPC bus (Keystone B, #13), the scheduler/tick (Keystone C, #14), and the Pimp job/threading system (#15). Companion docs: docs/reverse_engineer/{event_bus_code_map,scheduler_tick_code_map,pimp_job_system_code_map}.md.
_meta.method: Bridge from the Xbox decomp/PDB oracle (names + structure, docs/mercs2-pdb-analysis/*, pangea_engine_alignment.md) to the PC unpacked decomp (full bodies, symbol-stripped). Matched by behaviour/struct-offset/call-graph, not by name. The PC build recovers what Xbox stubbed; the residual gaps are SecuROM-virtualized indirect branches + a few stripped profiler-name strings, marked confirm-live.
